review.gallery: Nine visually matched developer renders extracted from the official 27-page brochure. Card focus keeps the Etherea facade in frame.
review.location: Map and named journey estimates visually checked on physical page 7. The website uses a project-name map query. The brochure’s ambiguous combined Ibn and Dubai Festival City label is left out of the destination list.
review.floorPlans: Eight apartment types visually read on physical pages 21, 23 and 24. The sheets retain the full paired layouts and printed notices. Studio 01 differs by 0.01 sq ft from its rounded components and its printed total is retained. The Madena and Profound plan documents repeat the same residential coverage. The Mitchell’s mirror adds the ground floor and five retail units, with all five area tables visually checked. On page 8 the Retail 03 header and G-03 tag agree, while the drawing also says Retail 02. The conflict is disclosed and the area agrees across the drawing and table.

unavailable: Verified entrance coordinates and an updated drawing resolving the Retail 03 internal label were not established.
